item.title: Khamarvest
item.description: Khamarvest is the oldest kind of production system (animals, feed, seasons) run with the same rule as software: show up every day, because none of it can be faked. The long dream is a whole village of integrated farming, where traditional agriculture meets sensors and automation, and a farm reaches everything it could be.

item.title: Khamarvest Silage
item.description: The silage arm of Khamarvest: grow and chop maize, ferment it right, and get honest feed to farms across Bangladesh. Inventory, logistics, and seasonal demand, the same problems software startups have, with heavier bags.
